register.reg_long_name: MPAM Long Memory Bandwidth Usage Monitor Register
register.power_domain_text: The power domain of MSMON_MBWU_L is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_MPAM_MSC_MSMON is implemented, MPAMF_MSMON_IDR.MSMON_MBWU == '1', and MPAMF_MBWUMON_IDR.HAS_LONG == '1'

reg_access_state.reg_access_level: When FEAT_MPAMv1p0 is implemented or FEAT_MPAMv0p1 is implemented
When FEAT_MPAMv1p0 is implemented or FEAT_MPAMv0p1 is implemented
When FEAT_RME is implemented and (FEAT_MPAMv1p0 is implemented or FEAT_MPAMv0p1 is implemented)
When FEAT_RME is implemented and (FEAT_MPAMv1p0 is implemented or FEAT_MPAMv0p1 is implemented)

purpose_text.para: Accesses the monitor instance selected by MSMON_CFG_MON_SEL.

configuration_text.para: If MPAMF_IDR.HAS_RIS is 1, the monitor instance long monitor register accessed is for the resource instance currently selected by MSMON_CFG_MON_SEL.RIS and the monitor instance of that resource instance selected by MSMON_CFG_MON_SEL.MON_SEL.
If FEAT_MPAMv0p1 or FEAT_MPAMv1p0 is implemented, the register is banked and the following statements apply:

content.para: MSMON_MBWU_L_s is the Secure long memory bandwidth usage monitor instance selected by the Secure instance of MSMON_CFG_MON_SEL.
MSMON_MBWU_L_ns is the Non-secure long memory bandwidth usage monitor instance selected by the Non-secure instance of MSMON_CFG_MON_SEL.
If FEAT_RME is implemented, the following statements also apply:
MSMON_MBWU_L_rt is the Root long memory bandwidth usage monitor instance selected by the Root instance of MSMON_CFG_MON_SEL.
MSMON_MBWU_L_rl is the Realm long memory bandwidth usage monitor instance selected by the Realm instance of MSMON_CFG_MON_SEL.

configuration_text.para: The power and reset domain of each MSC component is specific to that component.

field_description.para: Not Ready. Indicates whether the monitor instance has possibly inaccurate data.

field_value_description.para: The monitor instance is ready and the MSMON_MBWU_L.VALUE field is accurate.
The monitor instance is not ready and the contents of the MSMON_MBWU_L.VALUE field might be inaccurate or otherwise not represent the actual memory bandwidth usage.

field_description.para: Long (44-bit) memory bandwidth usage counter value if MSMON_MBWU_L.NRDY is 0. Invalid if MSMON_MBWU_L.NRDY is 1.

VALUE is the long count of bytes transferred since the monitor was last reset that met the criteria set in MSMON_CFG_MBWU_FLT and MSMON_CFG_MBWU_CTL for the monitor instance selected by MSMON_CFG_MON_SEL.
Not Ready. Indicates whether the monitor instance has possibly inaccurate data.

field_value_description.para: The monitor instance is ready and the MSMON_MBWU_L.VALUE field is accurate.
The monitor instance is not ready and the contents of the MSMON_MBWU_L.VALUE field might be inaccurate or otherwise not represent the actual memory bandwidth usage.

field_description.para: Long (63-bit) memory bandwidth usage counter value if MSMON_MBWU_L.NRDY is 0. Invalid if MSMON_MBWU_L.NRDY is 1.

VALUE is the long count of bytes transferred since the monitor instance was last reset that met the criteria set in MSMON_CFG_MBWU_FLT and MSMON_CFG_MBWU_CTL for the monitor instance selected by MSMON_CFG_MON_SEL.

access_permission_text.para: If both FEAT_MPAM and FEAT_RME are implemented, the following statements apply:

content.para: In a system that supports Secure, Non-secure, Root, and Realm memory maps, there must be MPAM feature pages in all four address maps:
MSMON_MBWU_L_s must only be accessible from the Secure MPAM feature page.
MSMON_MBWU_L_ns must only be accessible from the Non-secure MPAM feature page.
MSMON_MBWU_L_rt must only be accessible from the Root MPAM feature page.
MSMON_MBWU_L_rl must only be accessible from the Realm MPAM feature page.
MSMON_MBWU_L_s, MSMON_MBWU_L_ns, MSMON_MBWU_L_rt, and MSMON_MBWU_L_rl must be separate registers:
The Secure instance (MSMON_MBWU_L_s) accesses the long memory bandwidth usage monitor used for Secure PARTIDs.
The Non-secure instance (MSMON_MBWU_L_ns) accesses the long memory bandwidth usage monitor used for Non-secure PARTIDs.
The Root instance (MSMON_MBWU_L_rt) accesses the long memory bandwidth usage monitor used for Root PARTIDs.
The Realm instance (MSMON_MBWU_L_rl) accesses the long memory bandwidth usage monitor used for Realm PARTIDs.

access_permission_text.para: If any one of these features is implemented:

content.para: When RIS is implemented, reads and writes to MSMON_MBWU_L access the long memory bandwidth usage monitor instance for the bandwidth resource instance selected by MSMON_CFG_MON_SEL.RIS and the monitor instance selected by MSMON_CFG_MON_SEL.MON_SEL.
When RIS is not implemented, reads and writes to MSMON_MBWU_L access the long memory bandwidth usage monitor instance for the monitor instance selected by MSMON_CFG_MON_SEL.MON_SEL.

listitem.content: Reads and writes to MSMON_MBWU_L access the long memory bandwidth usage monitor for the monitor instance selected by MSMON_CFG_MON_SEL.MON_SEL.
